description: Requirement graph for the 2.0.0 certification. tooling/check-release-evidence.mjs evaluates every requirement against evidence under artifacts/release-2.0 bound to the current candidate id and writes artifacts/release-2.0/evidence-manifest.json. docs/release/2.0-final-closure-plan.md is the human-readable view and must name every id.

evidenceChecks.candidate-file: JSON whose candidateId and sourceFingerprint equal the current candidate.
evidenceChecks.release-run: A release:check report.json: scope FULL, candidateId equals current and did not change during the run; listed gates (or every gate when none are listed) PASS.
evidenceChecks.json-pass: JSON whose candidateId equals current, whose verdict (result, or the field named by resultPath) is PASS, and every assert [path, expected] holds.
evidenceChecks.json-pass-candidate: JSON whose candidateId equals current (a manifest with no pass/fail of its own).
evidenceChecks.file-exists: A file that describes the environment rather than the candidate (server fingerprint); presence only.
evidenceChecks.manual-evidence: spec/manual-evidence.json entry with status PASS and an evidence path; that evidence file is JSON with candidateId equal to current and result PASS.
evidenceChecks.readiness: docs/2.0-readiness-matrix.md has no release-blocking row outside PASS / N/A.

requirements.title: Candidate identity recorded and unchanged
requirements.validation: node tooling/release-candidate-id.mjs --write after freeze; every later evidence file carries the same candidateId.
requirements.passCondition: artifacts/release-2.0/candidate.json candidateId and sourceFingerprint equal the current tree.

requirements.title: Final Validation A: full release:check, every gate PASS
requirements.environment: Release host with local Flare core stack, web app on 127.0.0.1:1430, live accounts ui2-release-desktop / ui2-release-mobile
requirements.validation: FLARE_RELEASE_RUN_LABEL=final-A FLARE_ALLOW_LIVE_SEND=1 FLARE_LIVE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1430 FLARE_LIVE_USER=ui2-release-desktop FLARE_LIVE_PEER=ui2-release-mobile npm run release:check
requirements.passCondition: runs/final-A/report.json: scope FULL, every gate PASS including candidate-integrity, candidateId unchanged.

requirements.title: Final Validation B: second consecutive full release:check on the same candidate
requirements.environment: Same as REL-VALIDATION-A, started after A finished, no repository write in between
requirements.validation: Same command with FLARE_RELEASE_RUN_LABEL=final-B.
requirements.passCondition: runs/final-B/report.json: scope FULL, every gate PASS, same candidateId as A.

requirements.title: No flaky gate across A and B
requirements.validation: Compare A and B: no gate may fail in either run; no gate is retried or skipped to obtain a pass.
requirements.passCondition: A and B both all-PASS with the identical gate list.

requirements.title: Web live: real browser, web app, client SDK and server
requirements.environment: Local Flare core profile (AUTH_DEV_ISSUE local mode), web app dev server 127.0.0.1:1430, Chromium
requirements.validation: web-live-sdk gate inside A and B: two logins, open conversation, A->B and B->A with ACK, cross-user read, ordered burst x3, pin/unpin, unread/read, reload exactly-once with stable ids, no overflow, no runtime error.
requirements.passCondition: live-sdk/report.json result PASS for the candidate with LIVE_BACKEND=true, LIVE_SEND=true, SDK_MOCK=false, NETWORK_INTERCEPT=false; web-live-sdk PASS in A and B; server environment recorded.

requirements.title: Reproducible packs with audited contents
requirements.validation: package-certification gate: pack twice with --ignore-scripts, compare sha256, check forbidden paths and export targets.
requirements.passCondition: package-manifest.json and tarball-hash.txt for the candidate; no forbidden file; every export target shipped; packs identical.

requirements.title: Clean consumer from tarballs: typecheck, build, runtime
requirements.environment: Temp directory outside the repository, npm registry for vue / naive-ui / vite
requirements.validation: tests/consumers/vue-clean installed from the packed tarballs; imports primitives, an IM component, hooks, the platform adapter and its type, contracts, theme, i18n, root entry and tokens; vue-tsc, vite build, Chromium smoke.
requirements.passCondition: consumers.latest: install, typecheck, build and runtime.pass all true.

requirements.title: Clean consumer at the declared peer-dependency floor
requirements.environment: Same as PKG-CLEAN-CONSUMER with vue and naive-ui pinned to the peer range floor
requirements.validation: Same consumer with peers pinned to the lowest version the range admits.
requirements.passCondition: consumers.peer-floor: install, typecheck, build and runtime.pass all true.

requirements.title: One primitive does not ship the IM layer
requirements.validation: Build four entries (primitive via ./components, primitive via root, all components, vue+naive baseline) with a rollup module ledger.
requirements.passCondition: Primitive entries ship zero IM-layer modules and no markdown-it; the all-components control ships IM modules.

requirements.title: Migration guide replacements resolve from the published entries
requirements.validation: tests/consumers/vue-clean/src/migration-smoke.ts inside the consumer typecheck: replacements import from the named entries, removed symbols fail to import (@ts-expect-error), documented props exist.
requirements.passCondition: consumers.latest.migrationSmoke and consumers.peer-floor.migrationSmoke true.

requirements.title: Public API frozen and registered
requirements.validation: api-check --strict (./components = catalog, registry symbols on ./contracts ./composables ./utils exported), public component exports, packed export map, doc imports; publicApi fingerprint bound in candidate.json.
requirements.passCondition: api-check, design-system and package-contents PASS in A and B.

requirements.title: Tokens frozen: generated surfaces current, no raw regressions
requirements.validation: design-system gates generated tokens, theme contract, token fallbacks, token raw values, legacy tokens; tokens fingerprint bound in candidate.json.
requirements.passCondition: design-system PASS in A and B.

requirements.title: Documentation teaches only what ships
requirements.validation: check-doc-code (no removed symbol in guidance, documented imports resolve to published entries), doc links, component guides and coverage, release-report gate.
requirements.passCondition: design-system and release-report PASS in A and B.

requirements.title: Rendering security boundary
requirements.validation: security-boundary gate: 4 URL gates x 18 vectors, v-html allowlist, self-navigating anchors, markdown html:false.
requirements.passCondition: security-boundary PASS in A and B.

requirements.title: No dynamic code, only declared host-directed network calls, no telemetry
requirements.validation: security-audit gate over four kits' sources and dependency manifests.
requirements.passCondition: security/report.json result PASS for the candidate.

requirements.title: Runtime dependency tree has no critical or high vulnerability
requirements.environment: Clean consumer, npm audit registry endpoint
requirements.validation: npm audit --omit=dev on the clean consumer (kit, tokens, dependencies, peers).
requirements.passCondition: consumers.latest.audit.vulnerabilities.critical = 0 and high = 0.

requirements.title: Web accessibility automation
requirements.validation: accessibility-axe (every component preview + reference app, 44px coarse-pointer hit areas), website-interaction-visual (names, no positive tabindex, visible keyboard focus, reduced motion, forced colors), form keyboard contract.
requirements.passCondition: accessibility-axe, website-interaction-visual and form-keyboard-contract PASS in A and B (Critical 0, Serious 0).

requirements.title: Web list budgets measured on a real mount
requirements.validation: performance-budget gate: 1000 conversations / 5000 messages mounted, rendered rows and nodes per row counted.
requirements.passCondition: performance-budget PASS in A and B.

requirements.title: Visual regression against checked-in darwin baselines
requirements.validation: website-interaction-visual and conversation-state-visual-check; baseline manifest two-way check in design-system; per-file baseline hashes in artifacts/release-2.0/visual/baseline-hashes.json.
requirements.passCondition: Both gates PASS in A and B; baseline hash manifest generated for the candidate.

requirements.title: Linux CI visual regression with committed linux baselines
requirements.environment: GitHub Actions ubuntu job pinned per artifacts/release-2.0/ci/environment.json; the candidate must be pushed
requirements.validation: docs/release/2.0-external-validation.md §3: generate linux baselines in the pinned CI environment, review each image EXPECTED/REGRESSION, commit, rerun test:visual green in CI.
requirements.passCondition: ci/linux-visual.json from the CI run: result PASS, candidateId equal to current, zero unreviewed baselines.
requirements.externalEnvironment: Linux CI runner; this host is macOS arm64 and the working tree is not pushed

requirements.title: Web reference app tests, build and browser suite
requirements.validation: web-tests, web-build, web-browser, reference-ownership, reference-gate-tests, design-source.
requirements.passCondition: All six gates PASS in A and B.

requirements.title: iOS: kit tests, example tests, project generation, simulator build
requirements.environment: macOS release host, Xcode, generic iOS Simulator destination
requirements.validation: swift, ios-app-tests, ios-app-project, ios-app-build gates.
requirements.passCondition: All four PASS in A and B.

requirements.title: Android: kit unit/lint/release assemble, example unit/lint/assemble
requirements.validation: compose and android-app gates.
requirements.passCondition: Both PASS in A and B.

requirements.title: Flutter: kit analyze/tests, example analyze/tests/macOS build
requirements.validation: flutter-analyze, flutter-tests, flutter-app-analyze, flutter-app-tests, flutter-app-build gates.
requirements.passCondition: All five PASS in A and B.

requirements.title: Tauri: tests, frontend build, native cargo check
requirements.validation: tauri-tests, tauri-build, tauri-native gates.
requirements.passCondition: All three PASS in A and B.

requirements.title: iOS example runtime against the real backend
requirements.environment: iOS Simulator (available on this host) running flare-core-ios-app from the candidate against the local Flare core stack; level L6 PRODUCTION_LIKE on simulator
requirements.validation: docs/release/2.0-external-validation.md#native-ios-runtime: build, launch, login, conversation list, open conversation, send, receive, read, pin, message action, composer, keyboard, back.
requirements.passCondition: Every step observed with the expected result and no crash; sent text appears once on the peer with a stable id.

requirements.title: Android example runtime against the real backend
requirements.environment: Android emulator Pixel_9_API_35 (available on this host) running flare-core-android-app from the candidate against the local stack (10.0.2.2)
requirements.validation: docs/release/2.0-external-validation.md#native-android-runtime: same task list as NATIVE-IOS-RUNTIME plus system back and gesture navigation.
requirements.passCondition: Same as NATIVE-IOS-RUNTIME.

requirements.title: Flutter example runtime and semantics boundary
requirements.environment: flare-core-flutter-app macOS desktop build from the candidate against the local stack; the app renders flare_im_ui widgets, not a WebView
requirements.validation: docs/release/2.0-external-validation.md#native-flutter-runtime: launch, login, list, open, send, receive, read; Semantics tree inspected for conversation row, message, composer.
requirements.passCondition: Every step observed; semantics nodes carry labels for row, message and send.

requirements.title: Tauri desktop runtime
requirements.environment: flare-core-tauri-app desktop build from the candidate against the local stack
requirements.validation: docs/release/2.0-external-validation.md#native-tauri-runtime: launch, login, conversation, send, receive, read, file picker, image picker, clipboard, external URL (safeExternalUrl), window resize, keyboard navigation, overlay, close/reopen. Deep link and notification are not in the 2.0 Tauri contract (platform-fallback-policy.md) and are recorded N/A.
requirements.passCondition: Every applicable step observed with the expected result; javascript: links never open.

requirements.title: iOS pickers and permission UX
requirements.environment: iOS Simulator for Photos, Files, Microphone, Location, Notifications; physical iPhone for Camera
requirements.validation: docs/release/2.0-external-validation.md#native-permissions-ios: for each capability the host exposes — first request, allow, deny, cancel, request again, permanent denial — plus picker round trips (PHPicker, document picker).
requirements.passCondition: Selections reach the composer; cancel yields nothing and no error; denial gives feedback, a fallback or a disabled state — never an endless spinner, a dead button, a fake success or a re-prompt loop.

requirements.title: Android pickers and permission UX
requirements.environment: Android emulator for Photos, Files, Microphone, Location, Notifications (API 33+ runtime permission); physical phone for Camera
requirements.validation: docs/release/2.0-external-validation.md#native-permissions-android: same matrix as iOS; plus focus recovery after returning from the permission dialog with TalkBack on (physical).
requirements.passCondition: Same as NATIVE-PERMISSIONS-IOS.
requirements.externalEnvironment: Camera and TalkBack focus recovery require a physical phone

requirements.title: Background / foreground on mobile
requirements.environment: Simulator / emulator against the local stack (connection, sync, state); physical devices repeat under RESOURCE-*
requirements.validation: docs/release/2.0-external-validation.md#native-lifecycle-foreground: foreground -> background (30 s and 5 min) -> foreground; a message sent to the device while backgrounded.
requirements.passCondition: Connection resumes, conversation and message sync converge without duplicates, composer draft and open overlay survive, no stuck presence.

requirements.title: Safe area on notched and gesture-navigation devices

requirements.validation: docs/release/2.0-external-validation.md NATIVE-SAFE-AREA: conversation list, chat with keyboard open, sheet, image viewer.
requirements.passCondition: No control or text under the status bar, notch, home indicator or navigation bar; composer stays above the keyboard.
requirements.externalEnvironment: No physical iOS or Android device attached to this host

requirements.validation: docs/release/2.0-external-validation.md#native-ime-device: Chinese pinyin with candidates, emoji keyboard, keyboard switch, Enter during composition, multi-line, close/open keyboard.
requirements.passCondition: No accidental send during composition, no composer jump, no input loss.

requirements.passCondition: As defined in the matrix; recorded via spec/manual-evidence.json.

requirements.passCondition: criteria/report.json items.componentTests.result PASS: zero STABLE components without a test (2.0-release-criteria.md §1 component, §2).

requirements.passCondition: criteria/report.json items.responsive.result PASS (such a spec exists) and it passes inside website-interaction-visual in A and B.

requirements.title: Unsupported capabilities accepted for 2.0.0 by the release owner
